The stronger four-probe campaign separately passes both cases and fourteen steps. Every sign also distinguishes ignored angstrom/nm input units by a full cell. Actual Mol* positions and all native structures are checked against independent analytical arrays.

Original 300/240-second scenario deadlines and UI waits are unchanged. Browser errors remain matched explicitly to an independent plain-notebook debugger baseline, not silently suppressed.

All registered source/export inputs remain unchanged during clean receiving. No runtime implementation, optional engine, public scientific API, consumer tolerance, policy override or Rust code is introduced.
This receives an existing periodic intent and adds no scorecard leaf or defect-closure bonus. Human/installed/platform/final-candidate gates and the remaining GUI families stay required.
